title: Strontium Changes Lipid Profile, Release, and Function of Matrix Vesicles Produced by Mineralization-Competent Cells.
abstract: Mineral deposition in the extracellular matrix (ECM) is a highly organized process initiated by matrix vesicles (MVs) released from mineralization-competent cells, such as osteoblasts. In bone pathologies, osteogenic inducers (ions, hormones, nanoparticles) are becoming increasingly vital for the repair of damaged tissue. Among these inductors, strontium ranelate (SR), first suggested for treating osteoporotic patients, stands out.
